name: CHESTGOLD-cut-coins-uncounted
old:
taking.reduce((n, uid) => n + (coins(takenOf.get(uid)) ? (takenOf.get(uid).stackCount ?? 1) : 0), 0) +
        cuts.reduce((n, cut) => n + (coins(cut.give) ? (cut.give.stackCount ?? 1) : 0), 0);

name: CHESTGOLD-svc-settle-lapse-unsaid
old:
if (!(await ourHold(db, player, character, mapId, buildingKey, id, ctx.nowS)))
    return { error: await holdLost(db, player, character, mapId, buildingKey, id) };
new: if (!(await ourHold(db, player, character, mapId, buildingKey, id, ctx.nowS))) return { error: 'decor-busy' };

name: CHESTGOLD-svc-pour-any-row

                'DELETE FROM decor_bin WHERE map_id = ? AND building_key = ? AND piece_id = ? AND uid = ? AND item = ?',
              )
              .bind(mapId, buildingKey, id, row.uid, row.item),

.prepare('DELETE FROM decor_bin WHERE map_id = ? AND building_key = ? AND piece_id = ? AND uid = ?')
              .bind(mapId, buildingKey, id, row.uid),
